title: Intelligence Review — source first, no repetition
summary: The 09/09 review is implemented: Creator DNA is asked only after sign-in, source-video taxonomy is independent of the user's profile, the Monday Brief label is removed from the product UI, and evidence-mode Summary/Takeaways/Payoffs are rebuilt around distinct interpreted evidence rather than repeated transcript windows.
discord_changes: INTELLIGENCE FIX: Summary, Takeaways and Payoffs now de-duplicate evidence and separate interpretation from source receipts instead of printing overlapping transcript blocks.
SOURCE TAXONOMY: the strip now labels the VIDEO's niche/subniche from its own title/description/transcript evidence — Creator DNA can no longer leak into source metadata.
ACCOUNT FLOW: Creator DNA questions are hidden until the user signs in; signed-out users can still analyse source videos without being asked personalisation questions.
changes: Removed the user-facing 'Monday Brief' label while preserving the locked 17-section structure internally.
Added a source-video taxonomy pass for niche/subniche that is independent of the creator profile.
Replaced evidence-mode summary windows with 10-12 distinct chronological interpreted beats plus concise source receipts.
Added a source-derived main-message card and observable-mechanics why-it-likely-worked verdict without claiming private retention causality.
Rebuilt evidence-mode takeaways so each lesson is distinct and carries one exact timestamped source receipt; numbered/facts videos preserve real list items when available.
Rebuilt payoff detection around strong receipt/reveal/demonstration events, with spacing and semantic de-duplication, instead of every 30-second cue window.
Creator DNA onboarding is suppressed before auth and appears only after sign-in when no complete profile exists.
Preserved Group Video Analysis, Watchtower, Hook/Package/Style banks, account-backed Vault sync and zero-credit local multimodal paths from the v0.36 Endgame candidate.
Cache identity bumped so stale pre-review code is not silently reused.
known_limitations: Frontier cloud-model quality cannot be provided without a separately billed model API; zero-credit mode uses the strongest available on-device model plus deterministic source synthesis.
YouTube may not expose storyboard/direct-media sources on every request. Missing visual/audio sources stay explicitly unavailable rather than being fabricated.
Most Replayed is treated as real only when public curve data is exposed.
On-device multimodal model support depends on the user's browser/device and may require a local model download.
why_it_matters: The layout was already clean; this release makes the evidence-mode core materially less repetitive and stops user profile data from contaminating source-video analysis.
